purpose: Contrast ongoing behavior with a concern being ignored.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Ignoring his parents’ worries, the son continued traveling.
The cat slept on, oblivious to the commotion.
Despite everyone’s anticipation, the announcement was postponed.
restrictions: Often with 心配, 期待, or 騒ぎ.
mistake: It does not simply mean being located somewhere else.
